desc:
🖥️ Welcome to Gaming PC Building Simulator! Build custom Gaming PCs, run your own PC shop that is fully customizable, and become the best PC builder!

🛠️ Realistic PC Building with screw, insertion and latch mechanics
💵 Purchase PC parts at Computia, the worlds biggest PC part store
📋 Complete difficult orders and sell Gaming PCs to customers
🔷 Collect over 200+ parts and add them to your Index
👍 Visit other player's shops and like their displayed Gaming PCs!
🏗️ Build up your shop with a fully customizable plot building system
🏆 Climb your way to the top of the leaderboards!

📌 Join the group to interact with the community and get rewards!


📋 Developed by Reanimat3d with contributions from Kateyfilin829

UPDATE 1 Has Been Released!
Use codes UPDATEONE for free multipliers!
